% Blue-accent CV, adapted from a finished Word CV (same design as the original).
% Verified in the sandbox: compiles to ONE page with the sample data.
%
% The one rule that makes this template work: every multi-line placeholder sits
% inside an itemize, and an itemize REQUIRES \item before its content. Writing
% {{experience}} on its own line makes pdflatex die with
% "Something's wrong--perhaps a missing \item" and produce no PDF at all.
% Each placeholder already arrives with one hard line break per entry, so a
% single \item in front of it is enough — the following lines stay bullet-less
% because the list uses label={}.
\documentclass[10pt,a4paper]{article}

\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[margin=1.55cm]{geometry}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\usepackage{enumitem}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage[colorlinks=true]{hyperref}
\usepackage{parskip}
\usepackage{fancyhdr}
\usepackage{tabularx}
\usepackage{marvosym}
\usepackage{latexsym}

% Blue accent matching the original CV
\definecolor{accent}{HTML}{2563EB}
\definecolor{navy}{HTML}{1F2937}
\definecolor{greytext}{HTML}{555555}

\hypersetup{
  linkcolor=accent,
  urlcolor=accent,
  citecolor=accent
}

\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{}
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}
\renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{0pt}

\urlstyle{same}
\raggedright
\raggedbottom
\setlength{\tabcolsep}{0pt}

% Section titles — blue, compact, with rule
\titleformat{\section}
  {\vspace{-1pt}\color{accent}\scshape\raggedright\large}
  {}
  {0em}
  {}
  [\color{accent}\titlerule\vspace{-1pt}]

\titlespacing*{\section}{0pt}{6pt}{4pt}

\begin{document}

% ---------- HEADER ----------
\begin{center}
    \textbf{\Huge \scshape \color{navy} {{fullName}}} \\[3pt]
    \small \textbf{\color{accent} {{headline}}} \\[3pt]
    \footnotesize \color{greytext}
    {{phone}} $\quad|\quad$
    {{email}} \\[2pt]
    {{links}}
\end{center}

\vspace{4pt}

% ---------- PROFILE ----------
\section{Profil}
\begin{itemize}[
  leftmargin=0.18in,
  label={},
  itemsep=1.2pt,
  topsep=2pt,
  parsep=0pt
]
\small
\item {{profile}}
\end{itemize}

\vspace{-2pt}

% ---------- EXPERIENCE ----------
\section{Expérience}

\begin{itemize}[
  leftmargin=0.18in,
  label={},
  itemsep=1.2pt,
  topsep=2pt,
  parsep=0pt
]
\small
\item {{experience}}
\end{itemize}

\vspace{-2pt}

% ---------- EDUCATION ----------
\section{Formation}

\begin{itemize}[
  leftmargin=0.18in,
  label={},
  itemsep=1.2pt,
  topsep=2pt,
  parsep=0pt
]
\small
\item {{education}}
\end{itemize}

\vspace{-2pt}

% ---------- CERTIFICATES ----------
\section{Certificats}

\begin{itemize}[
  leftmargin=0.18in,
  label={},
  itemsep=1pt,
  topsep=2pt,
  parsep=0pt
]
\small
\item {{certificates}}
\end{itemize}

\vspace{-2pt}

% ---------- SKILLS ----------
\section{Compétences Techniques}

\begin{itemize}[
  leftmargin=0.18in,
  label={},
  itemsep=1pt,
  topsep=2pt,
  parsep=0pt
]
\small
\item {{skills}}
\end{itemize}

\end{document}
